work.title: Conversational AI for telecoms
work.summary: Designing a self-service route for customer enquiries with IBM Watson.
work.outcome: The implementation targeted automated enquiry handling and self-service.
work.challenge: Give customers of a major Australian telecoms provider a self-service route for enquiries.
work.role: I led IBM Watson technology consulting and owned the chatbot backlog at EdgeVerve.
work.approach: I prioritised user stories and ran daily Scrum meetings to organise the work around customer enquiries.

work.title: AI agents in enterprise workflows
work.summary: Using working prototypes to explore how agents interact with operational systems.
work.outcome: Demonstrated end-to-end agent workflows, system integration and automation.
work.challenge: Show how an agent can complete operational work across connected enterprise systems.
work.role: I built working retail, vendor-management and banking prototypes at DevRev.
work.approach: I connected REST APIs and AWS-hosted services so stakeholders could inspect the hand-offs between request, agent and system.

work.title: Technical evidence for enterprise buyers

perspectives.title: A convincing demo answers a buying question

perspectives.title: Treat enterprise readiness as product feedback
perspectives.copy: Repeated questions about data access, integrations or ownership reveal where the product needs to give buyers more confidence.
